title: How Skipping One Meal a Week Trains a Godly Man to Say No to Himself
caption:
One skipped meal a week teaches a godly man something a lecture can't: his hunger takes orders.

Pick one meal. Feel the pull. Pray instead of eating. Keep it quiet. Jesus said "when you fast," not "if," and the no you practice at lunch is the same no you'll need at 11 PM.

(If you have a medical condition or a history with disordered eating, skip this and talk to your doctor and a pastor first.)

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
